_about: Resource facts the virtual Pip reports in its Device internals, for the catalog product firmware (physical-st7789 release ELF). The `elf` block is generated from `bun scripts/firmware-budget.mjs --json` and checked against the current ELF by `bun scripts/virtual-resource-facts.mjs --check` (just fw-budget, firmware CI); refresh with `--write`. The `board` block is not in the ELF: it is the unit's flash layout (4 MiB module, espflash default partition table, factory app 0x3F0000 B), as the unit's internals panel shows it. See docs/virtual-pip.md (Modelled timing and internals).
